# SEO Season

> SEO Season (https://seoseason.com) is the SEO and AI search intelligence platform built by Manav S. It runs technical, on-page, off-page and GEO (generative engine optimization) audits. Its client-facing service for US small businesses is Business Santa (https://www.businesssanta.com), which uses SEO Season as its engine.

## How the two fit together
- SEO Season: the platform and the engine. Audits, research and intelligence, built by Manav S.
- Business Santa: the client-facing service. A real team (Jyoti, Manav S, Sam, Sakshi) helps US small businesses show up on Google, Google Maps and AI assistants such as ChatGPT. Free check, fixes from $120.

## Pages
- [SEO Season](https://seoseason.com/): the platform.
- [Business Santa](https://www.businesssanta.com/): free check and local SEO for US small businesses.
- [Business Santa services and prices](https://seoseason.com/businesssanta): the full service catalog.
- [Business Santa summary for AI assistants](https://www.businesssanta.com/llms.txt)
